blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Coast Guard personnel and disaster responders conducted search-and-rescue operations on Tuesday for a 54-year-old fisherman who went missing after his empty boat was found off Barangay Pinggan in Gasan, Marinduque. The Coast Guard Sub-Station Gasan, in coordination with the Gasan Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office, launched the search for Melchor Guevarra after no one was found onboard his boat at Sitio Catala in Barangay Pinggan.
